description_en: Deletes a folder from the Data Development page
description_zh: 调用DeleteFolder删除数据开发页面的文件夹
name: DeleteFolder

parameters.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. To obtain the workspace ID, log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Management page. You must set this parameter or ProjectIdentifier to specify the DataWorks workspace for the API call.
parameters.description_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间。
